positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Engage in Mobile Application Development for the Switch-IT team.
•	Create Software Architecture documents for Remote Seating.
•	Modify the firmware for Cool Cube product to better detect dual button taps.  The modification allows the product to change between forward and reverse.
•	Was responsible for bringing multiple documents up to Quality Analysis/ Regulatory standards.  Some of the doucmenmts include Software Architecture, Product Requirements, various test protocols and reports, and user validation,
•	Added countdown timer to the Remote Seating Application to indicate minutes to next Pressure Relief Cycle.
•	Added virtual confetti to indicate when a Pressure Relief cycle was completed succesfully by the end user.
